description.value: The study examined resting-state habenula functional connectivity in autistic and neurotypical participants, including group differences, developmental age-related variability, and associations with autism-related phenotypic measures.

spans.text: Lastly, a separate regression analysis was performed to examine associations between atypical habenula connectivity and phenotypic measures, including SM, SC, EF, and DLS.

design.value: Retrospective multisite resting-state functional MRI study using ABIDE I and II data, with whole-brain habenula seed-based functional connectivity analyses comparing ASD and NT groups and testing age and phenotypic associations.
